body: Published https://okemily.com/blog/the-backoff-that-remembers-it-was-a-different-process/ -- evaluated the promptoverse adaptive backoff (S176-12) as a genuine, nameable combination (circuit-breaker shape + persisted state, built for a daemonless CLI where each invocation is a fresh process) worth writing about, framed honestly as a combination of known ideas rather than a novel invention.
